biggest_catch: The referred friend must be a first-time Delta Community member opening both a Savings and a Checking Account, and complete 10 Visa debit card purchases within 60 days - ATM transactions do not count - or neither party gets paid.
catches: Referrer must be the Primary Accountholder of an active, open account with Delta Community; former members cannot refer.
Friend must be a first-time Delta Community member: open a consumer Savings Account ($5) and any consumer Checking Account within 90 days, using the Refer-A-Friend promo code at account opening.
Friend must deposit $50 to the Checking Account and make 10 Visa debit card purchases within 60 calendar days of account opening (ATM transactions excluded); accounts must be in good standing.
Bonus paid within 60 calendar days of all requirements being met; IRS reporting applies.
Cap: earn up to $500 per calendar year (10 referrals at $50 each); the promotion is described as 'for a limited time' so it can change.

steps: Visit DeltaCommunityCU.com/Refer to get your personal referral link.
Share your unique referral link with eligible friends via text, email, or social media.
Friend follows the link, gets a unique promo code, and opens Savings + Checking accounts (promo code applied at opening).
Friend deposits $50 to Checking and makes 10 Visa debit card purchases within 60 days of account opening.
Receive your $50 bonus within 60 days of all requirements being met.
timing: Bonus paid within 60 calendar days of all program requirements being met; track status in the Refer-A-Friend Dashboard.
when_cash_arrives: Bonus paid within 60 calendar days of all program requirements being met; track status in the Refer-A-Friend Dashboard. Paid after your friend completes the program's activity requirements - the friend's qualification is the gating step.
maximize: Have your friend knock out transaction counts in a single day (small purchases) and set up direct deposit on the first paycheck - do not let activity dribble across the window.
Verify the exact qualification checklist with the institution before referring - thin-terms programs often have unpublished requirements that void referrals.
Structural reason it cannot be faster: you only get paid if the friend completes real banking activity; a join-and-idle referral earns nothing.
